messages:
zoe: Quick design review: trying the compact rows option in the model catalog + compare table. Two things jumped out: the perf badge legend is hard to parse and the pinned-version affordance is easy to miss when density is high. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/compact-compare.png

rahul: Nice catch. On the legend: current tiny dot + 'Perf' label isn't obvious that it's median latency. People think it's a quality score. Could we add a small sparkline and label it 'Latency (ms)'?

eva: Sparkline is good but careful about clutter in compact mode. Maybe the legend expands on hover / focus to show more details: label + sample point tooltip. Keyboard users need a way to reach it though.

tony: For pinned versions: in compact rows the circular pin icon blends into the row actions. Proposal: move version pin to the left of the name as a small badge with text "Pinned vX.Y" when active. That keeps it visible even when density is reduced.

zoe: I like left-of-name badge. Needs to play nice with avatar and tags. Also avoid too many left-side columns. Could hide avatars in compact mode, move pin there.

rahul: Accessibility: pin change should announce via aria-live: "Pinned version 2025-02-14 for Model Foo". Also ensure the pin control is reachable via single tab and has an aria-label that includes the version.

eva: For the legend tooltip text: "Median latency at 512 tokens; lower is better. Calculated across last 7 days." Keep it short. Add a link within tooltip to performance docs.

ux-bot: Suggestion: make the legend keyboard focusable (tabindex=0) and use aria-describedby to associate the tooltip content.

tony: On animations: the compare table flyout currently slides in from the right with a 300ms easing; in compact rows the layout jump feels shaky. Consider cross-fade + scale instead of translate so text doesn't reflow. Less jank on density toggle.

zoe: Good point. Also microcopy: compact toggle label is currently "Compact rows" -> change to "Compact rows (dense)" so it's clearer what it does.

rahul: One more thing: filter presets. People want to save filter presets for performance testing, e.g., "Low-latency CPU quantized". Add a small star icon next to preset name to mark it favorite and expose it at the top. Favorites should sync per-org, with a tooltip "saved preset".

eva: Preset naming UX: allow free-text name + optional short description. Show description in hover. Keep creation lightweight — one-click save from current filters.

tony: Implementation constraints: we should avoid extra server calls on toggle; keep presets client-side until user clicks Save, then POST. Also consider rate-limiting save clicks.

zoe: Action items: 1) Tony — mock left-of-name pinned badge + compact row variant in Figma (due Mon). 2) Rahul — draft tooltip copy for legend + aria-live phrasing (due Tue). 3) Eva — microcopy edits: compact label + preset flow (due Tue). 4) UX-bot — weave keyboard focus notes into the accessibility checklist (due Wed).

rahul: I'll also run a quick VoiceOver pass on mac to confirm live-region phrasing.

eva: Thanks all, aiming to include visual changes + a11y fixes in next sprint.
